findings.title: Preflight preserved recovery JSON bound before entering storage-failure path
findings.reproduction: Use URL http://127.0.0.1:8765 plus 33000 trailing ASCII slashes, list a served model, and submit valid guidance. Backend and frontend URL validators accept because normalized URL is only local endpoint. Preserved exact JSON length is 33234 UTF-16 units. Store rejects its 32768 limit and latches StorageError without POST or storing an entry. Correct settings in the same document; submit stays disabled/blocked.
findings.recommendation: Preflight JSON.stringify(canonical exact request).length <= 32768 in shared RecoveryBody before persistence, returning a correctable form error for fresh input. Keep invalid preexisting evidence retained/fenced.
findings.reachability: Ordinary HTML URL input has no maxlength; repeated ASCII slashes form a valid URL path. Controller and actual backend validator reproduction confirmed; no separate Chromium run was performed.
